bar 80 20 (bullish)

Rule: range >= 4 ticks; opens in the top 20% and closes in the bottom 20% -> bullish (fade), mirror bearish. 83,862 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

bar 80 20 (bearish)

Rule: range >= 4 ticks; opens in the top 20% and closes in the bottom 20% -> bullish (fade), mirror bearish. 92,440 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

tall trend bar (bullish)

Rule: range > 1.46 x avgR22 and body >= 0.5 x range; direction of the body (continuation). 51,992 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

tall trend bar (bearish)

Rule: range > 1.46 x avgR22 and body >= 0.5 x range; direction of the body (continuation). 53,578 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

five lower lows higher highs (bullish)

Rule: 5 consecutive lower lows -> bullish (reversal); 5 higher highs -> bearish. 21,057 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.

five lower lows higher highs (bearish)

Rule: 5 consecutive lower lows -> bullish (reversal); 5 higher highs -> bearish. 25,319 occurrences on 15-minute bars across the three markets.
